title: LCB26 MP2/def2-TZVP analytic harmonic reference
summary: Optimize an exact ordered LCB26 geometry and compute its analytic MP2/def2-TZVP Cartesian Hessian through a certified SONIC ReadAllGIC KeyMaker job.
gates: exact LCB26 atom order and starting geometry
ORACLE perception followed by a complete symmetry-adapted SMITH SONIC chart
native GDV MP2/def2-TZVP Opt+Freq with ReadAllGIC
GDV detects the point group and follows it; forced PG and NoSymm are forbidden
two threads and 8 GB per authorized job
exact requested execution target with fail-closed routing
normal termination and one analytic Cartesian Hessian
Hessian-derived and printed harmonic frequencies agree within the importer tolerance
optimized geometry and Hessian are rigidly aligned to the immutable LCB26 frame
coordinate_policy: Retain the exact ordered LCB26 Cartesian seed, freeze the complete SMITH SONIC chart, transport it with ReadAllGIC, and rotate the final geometry and Hessian back to the parent LCB26 frame without remapping atoms.
backend_policy: KeyMaker alone authorizes and routes native GDV MP2/def2-TZVP Opt+Freq; GDV detects and follows symmetry, the requested host is mandatory, and neither direct backend launch nor NoSymm nor forced PG is permitted.
